approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content, and the user previously requested reducing manual imports.
notes: An email with several supported attachments currently requires one full inspection and one reviewer click per attachment.
Add a bounded explicit batch selection that parses the email once, prevalidates every index/hash, then reuses the existing immutable upload path for each selected attachment.
Keep individual import compatibility, parent provenance, capacity/chunk/hash/dedupe controls, inert nested content and no automatic analysis.
Completed with 653 Python, 24 UI, 11 deployment and 13 browser regression checks; the browser run made zero model calls and zero external requests.
title: Batch selected email attachment imports
objective: Let a reviewer explicitly import a bounded batch of selected EML/MSG attachments after one inspection while preserving all existing safety, provenance and no-auto-analysis boundaries.
